messages:
maria: Quick sync — finance asked for a repeatable way to allocate spot savings to teams that accounts for interruption risk and price variance. I sketched a risk-adjusted unit-econ proposal below, want feedback by EOD. :wave:

aj: +1. can you paste the calc?

maria: TL;DR proposal: 1) Compute realized gross savings = (OD_price - spot_price_realized) * spot_hours. 2) Subtract interruption cost = interruption_rate * avg_work_loss_hours * OD_price. 3) Holdback (buffer pool) = 15% of gross_savings to cover tail volatility & retries. 4) Net distributable = gross_savings - interruption_cost - buffer_pool. 5) Chargeback: distribute net distributable proportionally by project-tagged spot-hours, with regional multiplier for high-volatility zones. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: Example calc (6-week rolling):
```
OD_price = $3.20/hr
spot_mean = $0.95/hr
spot_hours = 32,400
interruption_rate = 0.029  # 2.9% (observed)
avg_work_loss_hours = 0.25 # avg work lost per interruption (requeues, warmup)

# gross savings
gross_savings = (3.20 - 0.95) * 32_400 = $74,880

# interruption cost
interruption_cost = interruption_rate * avg_work_loss_hours * OD_price * spot_hours
                   = 0.029 * 0.25 * 3.20 * 32_400 ≈ $2,377

# buffer pool (15%)
buffer_pool = 0.15 * gross_savings = $11,232

# net distributable
net = 74,880 - 2,377 - 11,232 = $61,271
```

samir: I like the structure. A few thoughts: use median spot price for pricing skew (outliers) or a trim (5%). interruption_rate should be weighted by region and instance type (A100 vs T4). Also make buffer pool dynamic: 10-20% depending on observed variance (CV of spot price).

jess: For chargeback mechanics, recommend monthly credits appear as negative line items on the infra bill. Example allocation CSV to hand to finance:
```
project_tag,spot_hours,region_multiplier,allocated_net_credit
search-retrieval,6_400,1.0,$12,100
chat-api,9_800,1.1,$20,900
experiments,16_200,0.9,$28,271
```

kyle: Note region volatility: us-west region historically has 2x CV vs us-east. suggest region_multiplier = 1 + (CV_region / CV_baseline - 1) * 0.5 to avoid overreacting. :warning:

olivia: I can run the 6-week simulation with per-instance-type breakdown. will include Monte Carlo of interruptions (n=10k) to produce 90% CI for distributable amount. ETA EOD tomorrow.

finance-bot: Report generated for 6 weeks: total_OD_hours=45,200; total_spot_hours=32,400; realized_gross_savings=$74,880; observed_interruptions=940 (2.9%); mean_spot_price=$0.95; CV_spot=0.18. CSV export available at https://redwood.internal/reports/spot-6w.csv

maria: Nice — next steps: Olivia + Samir run sims and produce per-team allocation spreadsheet + recommended buffer percentage by region. Jess to confirm billing format with finance. Kyle to provide regional CV numbers. Ops-bot, tag this thread as action-required. :memo:

ops-bot: Action created — "spot-savings-sim" assigned to olivia, samir, due 2026-03-20.

maria: Thanks everyone. If the sim shows net distributable < 50% of gross savings for a region, we should default to a conservative 10% credit (flag to product). :thumbsup:
